_meta.source: internlm/WildClawBench README — 'Harness comparison', four scaffolds on the same 60 tasks and graders
_meta.note: Aggregate 60-task scores in percent. Published by the benchmark authors, not measured here. Genus is absent because the authors did not run it; placing Genus in this table requires running our harness on one of these models, which is why the model column matters more than it looks.
_meta.why_this_file: The project's competitive framing was OpenClaw-vs-Genus. These numbers say OpenClaw is the best harness on ZERO of four models and Hermes on three. Front-runner means beating Hermes, which is a higher bar than the one that has been measured against.
